player_prompt.intro:
Nge uá Mufwasa {player_id} mu Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma kuluka {num_rounds} dikanda.

Mfumo wa Jogo:
- Mbele ya kuamua, nge una {total_conversation_rounds} mviringo ya kupaneka maluveru.
- Kuamua, bantu babiri bafanya kuamua kwa kusunga kana kubula.

Tabela ya Mbalansi (ifwa kuwa sawa kwa kila dikanda):
- Bantu babiri Basunga ➜ kila mmoja {cooperate_reward}
- Bantu babiri Babula ➜ kila mmoja {mutual_defect_reward}
- Mufwasa umwe Ubula, umwe Usunga ➜ Mbuli {defect_reward}, Mfwasa {sucker_reward}

Nge uá Mufwasa:
- Ku paneka maluveru: tanga maluveru nge ufwete.
- Kuamua: tanga '[Cooperate]' kana '[Defect]' (kana kikokoto kuwa na kisikwama). Nge ufwete kuongeza maluveru mbele/ku mwanda wa token.

phases.conversation_finished: Kuluta kukomana imwena kwa {round}. Nika ulwe na '[Cooperate]' or '[Defect]' mu 📦{{}}.

outcome.round_both_cooperate: O kiiadi kiki, a kalakala kumoxi.
